blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—National University maintained its grip on the second seed in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament with a 75-71 win over the University of Santo Tomas at Araneta Coliseum on Saturday. The Bulldogs bounced back from a 69-65 loss to Ateneo on Wednesday to improve to a 7-3 record, just a half game behind top-seeded State U at 7-2. “[It’s a] good win for us, definitely. Firstly, UST is not just another team. They’re still contenders,” coach Jeff Napa said of the Growling Tigers, who lost their third straight game. […]...
